javax.accessibility

接口 AccessibleTable

  • 所有已知子接口:
    AccessibleExtendedTable
    所有已知实现类:
    JTable.AccessibleJTable

    public interface AccessibleTable
    Class AccessibleTable describes a user-interface component that presents data in a two-dimensional table format.
    从以下版本开始:
    1.3
    作者:
    Lynn Monsanto
